findings.title: False success notification
findings.evidence: Click with blank amount displays Success without backend
findings.expected: Show success only after confirmed server response
findings.recommendation: Add pending/error/unknown transition via existing notification pattern
findings.verification: Submit with blank amount and simulated timeout, ensure success never appears without confirmed result.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

findings.title: Missing amount label
findings.evidence: input amount has placeholder but no label
findings.expected: Persistent label with currency and linked errors
findings.impact: User can confuse units and field purpose
findings.verification: Fill amount and inspect persistent label and accessible name with screen reader.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

findings.title: No amount validation
findings.expected: Block invalid operation and display field-local error
findings.recommendation: Define domain rules with product owner, add validation and focus behavior
findings.verification: Submit empty, zero, negative and malformed examples; verify no request and clear correction.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.
